name: bitmovin-observability-root-cause-analysis
description: Portable Bitmovin QoE root-cause-analysis skill packaged for Codex as a local plugin.

interface.shortDescription: Find out why a video QoE metric moved using Bitmovin Observability
interface.longDescription: Runs root-cause analysis for a video QoE metric that moved — startup time, rebuffer ratio, error rate, bitrate, or video-start-failures — using the Bitmovin Observability MCP. Drives a disciplined Define→Gather→Reflect→Conclude investigation with mix-vs-rate (Simpson's paradox) protection and a falsification step, producing a structured findings object that explains the delta between two windows or cohorts.
defaultPrompt: Why is rebuffering up in APAC this week?
Did the v11 release regress startup time?
What happened to error rate on Tuesday?
